title: Testing a statement
observableEvidence: Determines whether a value makes an equation true by substituting and evaluating the statement.
prompt: Does x = 6 make the equation 2x + 1 = 13 true? Explain by substitution.
solutionRepresentation: Yes. Substitution gives 2(6) + 1 = 12 + 1 = 13, so the equation is true.
solutionMethod: Replace the variable with the proposed value and compare the resulting two sides.

deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept any clear substitution showing that both sides have the same value.

hintSteps.prompt: To test a proposed value, replace the variable with that value and evaluate both sides.
hintSteps.question: What expression results when x is replaced by the proposed number?

review.originalityStatement: New candidate item drafted from first principles for this repository; it does not reproduce or paraphrase proprietary or contest material.

accessibilityNotes: Present the equation and proposed value in linear text; no balance-scale graphic is required.
accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: Test whether six makes two times x plus one equal thirteen by replacing x with six and comparing the result.
